The alchemist takes a –2 penalty on both associated mental ability scores as long as the mutagen persists.

semanticContracts.name: Madness bomb L421
conditions: An alchemist must be at least 12th level before selecting this discovery.

semanticContracts.name: Eternal potion L409
conditions: An alchemist must be at least 16th level and must possess the extend potion discovery before selecting this discovery.

semanticContracts.name: Grand mutagen L416
conditions: An alchemist must be at least 16th level and must possess the greater mutagen discovery before selecting this discovery.
The alchemist takes a –2 penalty to his Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma as long as the mutagen persists (see Mutagen).

semanticContracts.name: Inferno bomb* L419
conditions: An alchemist must be at least 16th level and must possess the smoke bomb discovery before selecting this discovery.

semanticContracts.name: Concussive bomb* L403
conditions: An alchemist must be at least 6th level before selecting this discovery.
Concussive bomb* : When the alchemist creates a bomb, he can choose to have it inflict sonic damage.
Creatures that take a direct hit from a concussive bomb are deafened for 1 minute unless they succeed at a Fortitude save.

semanticContracts.name: Sticky poison L427
conditions: An alchemist must be at least 6th level before selecting this discovery.

semanticContracts.name: Force bomb* L414
conditions: An alchemist must be at least 8th level before selecting this discovery.
Creatures that take a direct hit from a force bomb are knocked prone unless they succeed on a Reflex save.
Force bomb* : When the alchemist creates a bomb, he can choose to have it inflict force damage.
Force bombs deal 1d4 points of force damage, plus 1d4 points of force damage for every odd-numbered level, instead of 1d6.

semanticContracts.name: Fast bombs L412
conditions: An alchemist must be at least 8th level before selecting this discovery.

semanticContracts.name: Combine extracts L401
conditions: An alchemist must be at least 8th level before selecting this discovery.
This extract has a level two levels higher than the highest-level formulae placed in the extract.

semanticContracts.name: True Mutagen L441
conditions: An alchemist must possess the grand mutagen discovery before selecting this discovery.
The alchemist takes a –2 penalty to his Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma as long as the mutagen persists (see Mutagen).

semanticContracts.name: Stink bomb* L428
conditions: An alchemist must possess the smoke bomb discovery before selecting this discovery.

semanticContracts.name: Infusion L420
conditions: An infused extract can be imbibed by a non-alchemist to gain its effects.

semanticContracts.name: Domain L412
conditions: An inquisitor does not gain the bonus spells listed for each domain, nor does she gain bonus spell slots.
Each domain grants a number of domain powers, depending on the level of the inquisitor.
If the inquisitor has cleric levels, one of her two domain selections must be the same domain selected as an inquisitor.
Levels of cleric and inquisitor stack for the purpose of determining domain powers and abilities, but not for bonus spells.
The inquisitor uses her level as her effective cleric level when determining the power and effect of her domain powers.

semanticContracts.name: Spells L410
conditions: In effect, the oracle loses the old spell in exchange for the new one.
She cannot swap any cure or inflict spells, nor can she swap any spells gained from her mystery.
The new spell's level must be the same as that of the spell being exchanged.

semanticContracts.name: Mystery L412
conditions: An oracle must pick one mystery upon taking her first level of oracle.
Mystery : Each oracle draws upon a divine mystery to grant her spells and powers.
Once made, this choice cannot be changed.
Regardless of its source, the mystery manifests in a number of ways as the oracle gains levels.

semanticContracts.name: Oracle's Curse (Ex) L414
conditions: An oracle's curse is based on her oracle level plus one for every two levels or Hit Dice other than oracle.
Each oracle must choose one of the following curses.
The oracle's curse cannot be removed or dispelled without the aid of a deity.
This choice is made at 1st level, and once made, it cannot be changed.

semanticContracts.name: Friend to the Animals (Ex) L529
conditions: Animals within 30 feet of you receive a bonus on all saving throws equal to your Charisma modifier.
Friend to the Animals (Ex) : Add all summon nature's ally spells to your spell list.
You must still select these spells using your allotment of spells known.

semanticContracts.name: Nature's Whispers (Ex) L532
conditions: You may add your Charisma modifier, instead of your Dexterity modifier, to your Armor Class and CMD.

semanticContracts.name: Blizzard (Su) L559
conditions: You can create one 10-foot-cube of storm per oracle level.
You must be 11th level to select this revelation.

semanticContracts.name: Firestorm (Su) L466
conditions: You can create one 10-foot cube of fire per oracle level.
You must be at least 11th level to select this revelation.

semanticContracts.name: Aspect (Su) L423
conditions: He cannot select any evolution that the eidolon could not possess, and he must be able to meet the requirements as well.
He cannot select the ability increase evolution through this ability.

semanticContracts.name: Rogue Talent L421
conditions: Any talent effects based on rogue level use the slayer's class level.
If the rogue talent has a prerequisite, the slayer must meet the prerequisite before taking that rogue talent.

semanticContracts.name: Energy Body (Su) L498
conditions: You choose whether or not to heal a creature when it passes through your space.
You may remain in energy body form for a number of rounds per day equal to your oracle level.

semanticContracts.name: Steelbreaker Skin (Su) L550
conditions: Anytime a melee or ranged weapon strikes you, the weapon takes an amount of damage equal to your oracle level.
At 15th level, the damage from this ability ignores up to 10 points of hardness.
This ability does not prevent the weapon from harming you unless the damage destroys the weapon attacking you.
You can use this ability once per day, but the duration is 1 minute/level.
You must be at least 7th level to select this revelation.

semanticContracts.name: Ki Range (Su) L465
conditions: Apply this benefit before doubling the range increment with the Far Shot feat.

semanticContracts.name: Arcane Archivist (Su) L511
conditions: Once per day, you can cast a spell from the sorcerer/wizard spell list as if it were on your list of spells known.
The spell consumes a spell slot one level higher than the level of the spell.
You must be at least 11th level to select this revelation.
You must have a spellbook containing the spell to cast it in this way, and the spell is erased when you complete the casting.

semanticContracts.name: Arcane Pool (Su) L395
conditions: The pool refreshes once per day when the magus prepares his spells.
This arcane pool has a number of points equal to 1/2 his magus level (minimum 1) + his Intelligence modifier.

semanticContracts.name: Armor of Bones (Su) L447
conditions: Armor of Bones (Su) : You can conjure armor made of bones that grants you a +4 armor bonus.
At 13th level, this armor grants you DR 5/bludgeoning.
At 7th level, and every four levels thereafter, this bonus increases by +2.
This duration does not need to be consecutive, but it must be spent in 1-hour increments.
You can use this armor for 1 hour per day per oracle level.

semanticContracts.name: For the Faith (Ex) L444
conditions: For the Faith (Ex) : At 8th level, the cavalier can call upon his faith to bolster himself in combat.
In addition, any allies within 30 feet that share his faith also receive half this bonus (minimum +1).

semanticContracts.name: Lion's Call (Ex) L425
conditions: Lion's Call (Ex) : At 2nd level, an order of the lion cavalier gains the ability to rally his allies.

semanticContracts.name: Master Slayer (Ex) L451
conditions: Master Slayer (Ex) : At 20th level, the slayer becomes a master at capturing or killing his studied targets.
The DC of this save is 10 + 1/2 the slayer's level + the slayer's Intelligence modifier.
Whether or not the target succeeds, it cannot be targeted by this ability again (by any slayer) for 24 hours.

semanticContracts.name: For the King (Ex) L426
conditions: For the King (Ex) : At 8th level, an order of the lion cavalier can call out to his allies, inspiring them to greatness.
This bonus lasts for 1 round.

semanticContracts.name: Ki Pool (Su) L441
conditions: As long as he has at least 1 point in his ki pool, he can make a ki strike.
At 10th level, his unarmed attacks are also treated as lawful weapons for the purpose of overcoming damage reduction.
At 7th level, his unarmed attacks are also treated as cold iron and silver for the purpose of overcoming damage reduction.
Ki Pool (Su) : At 3rd level, a monk gains a pool of ki points, supernatural energy he can use to accomplish amazing feats.
The number of points in a monk's ki pool is equal to 1/2 his monk level + his Wisdom modifier.

semanticContracts.name: By My Honor (Ex) L452
conditions: As long as he maintains the selected alignment, he receives a +2 morale bonus to one saving throw of his choice.
By My Honor (Ex) : At 2nd level, the cavalier must select one alignment.

semanticContracts.name: Banner (Ex) L391
conditions: At 10th level, and every five levels thereafter, these bonuses increase by +1.
Banner (Ex) : At 5th level, a cavalier's banner becomes a symbol of inspiration to his allies and companions.
The banner must be at least Small or larger and must be carried or displayed by the cavalier or his mount to function.

semanticContracts.name: Deliver Touch Spells (Su) L490
conditions: As usual, if the witch casts another spell before the touch is delivered, the touch spell dissipates.
Deliver Touch Spells (Su) : If a witch is 3rd level or higher, her familiar can deliver touch spells or hexes for her.

semanticContracts.name: Haunted L417
conditions: At 10th level, add telekinesis to your list of spells known.
At 15th level, add reverse gravity to your list of spells known.
At 5th level, add levitate and minor image to your list of spells known.
Retrieving any stored item from your gear requires a standard action, unless it would normally take longer.

semanticContracts.name: Poison Resistance (Ex) L429
conditions: At 10th level, an alchemist becomes completely immune to poison.
Poison Resistance (Ex) : At 2nd level, an alchemist gains a +2 bonus on all saving throws against poison.
This bonus increases to +4 at 5th level, and then again to +6 at 8th level.

semanticContracts.name: Spirit of Nature (Su) L534
conditions: At 10th level, the ability works everywhere, even in civilized or wholly artificial realms.
At 15th level, you gain fast healing 3 for 1d4 rounds when reduced to negative hit points.
At 5th level, you gain fast healing 1 for 1d4 rounds whenever you are reduced to negative hit points.

semanticContracts.name: Purity L421
conditions: At 10th level, the bonus is doubled against curses, diseases, and poisons.
Purity : The inquisitor is protected from the vile taint of her foes, gaining a +1 sacred bonus on all saving throws.
This bonus increases by +1 for every five inquisitor levels she possesses.

semanticContracts.name: Smiting L424
conditions: If the inquisitor is neutral, she does not receive this bonus.
The type selected must match one of the inquisitor's alignments.

semanticContracts.name: Resiliency L422
conditions: At 10th level, this DR changes from magic to an alignment (chaotic, evil, good, or lawful) that is opposite the inquisitor's.
This DR increases by 1 for every five levels she possesses.

semanticContracts.name: Protection L420
conditions: At 10th level, this bonus is doubled against attack rolls made to confirm critical hits against the inquisitor.
Protection : The inquisitor is surrounded by a protective aura, granting a +1 sacred bonus to Armor Class.
This bonus increases by +1 for every five inquisitor levels she possesses.

semanticContracts.name: Justice L418
conditions: At 10th level, this bonus is doubled on all attack rolls made to confirm critical hits.
Justice : This judgment spurs the inquisitor to seek justice, granting a +1 sacred bonus on all attack rolls.
This bonus increases by +1 for every five inquisitor levels she possesses.

semanticContracts.name: Tongues L419
conditions: At 10th level, you can understand any spoken language, as if under the effects of tongues , even during combat.
At 15th level, you can speak and understand any language, but your speech is still restricted during combat.
At 5th level, pick an additional language to speak in combat and add it to your list of known languages.
Whenever you are in combat, you can only speak and understand the selected language.
You gain the selected language as a bonus language.

semanticContracts.name: Stone Stability (Ex) L551
conditions: At 10th level, you gain Greater Trip as a bonus feat.
At 5th level, you gain Improved Trip as a bonus feat.
You do not need to meet the prerequisites to gain these feats.

semanticContracts.name: Clouded Vision L415
conditions: At 10th level, you gain blindsense out to a range of 30 feet.
At 15th level, you gain blindsight out to a range of 15 feet.
At 5th level, this distance increases to 60 feet.
You cannot see anything beyond 30 feet, but you can see as if you had darkvision.

semanticContracts.name: Wasting L420
conditions: At 10th level, you gain immunity to disease.
At 15th level, you are immune to the nauseated condition.
At 5th level, you are immune to the sickened condition (but not nauseated).
You gain a +4 competence bonus on saves made against disease.
You take a –4 penalty on Charisma-based skill checks, except for Intimidate .

semanticContracts.name: Deaf L416
conditions: At 10th level, you gain scent and you do not suffer any penalty on initiative checks due to being deaf.
At 15th level, you gain tremorsense out to a range of 30 feet.
Deaf : You cannot hear and suffer all of the usual penalties for being deafened.
This does not increase their level or casting time.
You cast all of your spells as if they were modified by the Silent Spell feat.

semanticContracts.name: Lure of the Heavens (Su) L484
conditions: At 10th level, you gain the ability to fly , as per the spell, for a number of minutes per day equal to your oracle level.
At 1st level, you no longer leave tracks.
At 5th level, you can hover up to 6 inches above the ground or even above liquid surfaces, as if levitating.
This duration does not need to be consecutive, but it must be spent in 1-minute increments.

semanticContracts.name: Transcendental Bond (Su) L535
conditions: At 10th level, you may use this bond to cast a touch spell on a designated ally once per day.
You may communicate with your allies for a number of rounds per day equal to your oracle level as if using telepathic bond .

semanticContracts.name: Cinder Dance (Ex) L464
conditions: At 10th level, you receive Acrobatic Steps as a bonus feat.
At 5th level, you receive Nimble Moves as a bonus feat.
Oracles with the lame oracle curse cannot select this revelation.

semanticContracts.name: Wings of Air (Su) L584
conditions: At 10th level, your speed increases to 90 feet and your maneuverability increases to perfect.
This duration does not need to be consecutive, but it must be spent in 1-minute increments.
You can use these wings for 1 minute per day per oracle level.
You must be at least 7th level to select this revelation.

semanticContracts.name: Lame L418
conditions: At 10th level, your speed is never reduced by armor.
At 15th level, you are immune to the exhausted condition.
At 5th level, you are immune to the fatigued condition (but not exhaustion).

semanticContracts.name: Flurry of Blows (Ex) L412
conditions: At 11th level, a monk can make an additional attack at his highest base attack bonus whenever he makes a flurry of blows.

semanticContracts.name: Touch of Acid (Su) L552
conditions: At 11th level, any weapon that you wield deals +1d6 points of acid damage, similar to how a flaming weapon operates.

semanticContracts.name: Touch of Flame (Su) L471
conditions: At 11th level, any weapon that you wield is treated as a flaming weapon.

semanticContracts.name: Wintry Touch (Su) L568
conditions: At 11th level, any weapon that you wield is treated as a frost weapon.

semanticContracts.name: Touch of Electricity (Su) L581
conditions: At 11th level, any weapon that you wield is treated as a shock weapon.

semanticContracts.name: Near Death (Su) L450
conditions: At 11th level, the bonus increases to +4.
At 7th level, this bonus also applies on saves against death effects, sleep effects, and stunning.
Near Death (Su) : You gain a +2 insight bonus on saves against diseases, mind-affecting effects, and poisons.

semanticContracts.name: Freezing Spells (Su) L562
conditions: At 11th level, the duration increases to 1d4 rounds.

semanticContracts.name: Vortex Spells (Ex) L582
conditions: At 11th level, the duration increases to 1d4 rounds.

semanticContracts.name: Form of Flame (Su) L467
conditions: At 11th level, you can assume the form of a Large fire elemental, as elemental body III .
At 13th level, you can assume the form of a Huge fire elemental, as elemental body IV .
At 9th level, you can assume the form of a Medium fire elemental, as elemental body II .
You can use this ability once per day, but the duration is 1 hour/level.
You must be at least 7th level to select this revelation.

semanticContracts.name: Water Form (Su) L566
conditions: At 11th level, you can assume the form of a Large water elemental, as elemental body III .
At 13th level, you can assume the form of a Huge water elemental, as elemental body IV .
At 9th level, you can assume the form of a Medium water elemental, as elemental body II .
You can use this ability once per day, but the duration is 1 hour/level.
You must be at least 7th level to select this revelation.

semanticContracts.name: War Sight (Su) L439
conditions: At 11th level, you can roll for initiative three times and take any one of the results.

semanticContracts.name: Resiliency (Ex) L436
conditions: At 11th level, you do not lose a hit point when you take a standard action while disabled.
At 7th level, you gain Diehard as a bonus feat.

semanticContracts.name: Maneuver Mastery (Ex) L435
conditions: At 11th level, you gain the Greater feat (such as Greater Trip ) that grants you a bonus when performing that maneuver.
At 7th level, you gain the Improved feat (such as Improved Trip ) that grants you a bonus when performing that maneuver.
Maneuver Mastery (Ex) : Select one type of combat maneuver.

semanticContracts.name: Stunning Fist (Ex) L414
conditions: At 12th level, he can make the target staggered for 1d6+1 rounds.
At 16th level, he can permanently blind or deafen the target.
At 20th level, he can paralyze the target for 1d6+1 rounds.
At 4th level, the monk can choose to make the target fatigued.
At 8th level, he can make the target sickened for 1 minute.
Stunning Fist (Ex) : At 1st level, the monk gains Stunning Fist as a bonus feat, even if he does not meet the prerequisites.
The monk must choose which condition will apply before the attack roll is made.
This condition replaces stunning the target for 1 round, and a successful saving throw still negates the effect.

semanticContracts.name: Weapon Mastery (Ex) L440
conditions: At 12th level, you gain Greater Weapon Focus with that weapon.
At 8th level, you gain Improved Critical with that weapon.
Weapon Mastery (Ex) : Select one weapon with which you are proficient.
You gain Weapon Focus with that weapon.

semanticContracts.name: Ice Armor (Su) L563
conditions: At 13th level, this armor grants you DR 5/piercing.
At 7th level, and every four levels thereafter, this bonus increases by +2.
Ice Armor (Su) : You can conjure armor of ice that grants you a +4 armor bonus.
In cold conditions, the armor bonus (and DR bonus) increases by 2; in very hot conditions it decreases by 2.
This duration does not need to be consecutive, but it must be spent in 1-hour increments.
You can use this armor for 1 hour per day per oracle level.

semanticContracts.name: Coat of Many Stars (Su) L480
conditions: At 13th level, this armor grants you DR 5/slashing.
At 7th level, and every four levels thereafter, this bonus increases by +2.
Coat of Many Stars (Su) : You conjure a coat of starry radiance that grants you a +4 armor bonus.
The duration does not need to be consecutive; it can instead be spent in 1-hour increments.
You can use this coat for 1 hour per day per oracle level.

semanticContracts.name: Style Strike (Ex) L482
conditions: At 9th level, and every 4 levels thereafter, a monk learns an additional style strike.
He must choose which style strike to apply before the attack roll is made.
Style Strike (Ex) : At 5th level, a monk can learn one type of style strike.
The monk can choose from any of the following strikes.

semanticContracts.name: Water Sight (Su) L567
conditions: At 7th level, you can use any calm pool of water at least 1 foot in diameter as a scrying device, as if using the scry spell.

semanticContracts.name: Major Healing (Su) L456
conditions: At 15th level, this hex acts like cure critical wounds .
Once a creature has benefited from the major healing hex, it cannot benefit from it again for 24 hours.
This acts as cure serious wounds , using the witch's caster level.

semanticContracts.name: Raise the Dead (Su) L451
conditions: At 15th level, you can summon an advanced skeleton or zombie.
At 7th level, you can summon a bloody skeleton or fast zombie.
The undead creature has a number of Hit Dice equal to your oracle level.
You can use this ability once per day plus one additional time per day at 10th level.

semanticContracts.name: Iron Skin (Su) L434
conditions: At 15th level, you can use this ability twice per day.
This functions as stoneskin , using your oracle level as the caster level.
You must be at least 11th level to select this revelation.

semanticContracts.name: Whirlwind Lesson (Ex) L520
conditions: At 15th level, you may share your whirlwind lesson with a number of characters equal to your oracle level.

semanticContracts.name: Slayer's Advance (Ex) L445
conditions: At 17th level, he can use this ability twice per day.
He can use Stealth as part of this movement, but takes a –10 penalty on his check for doing so.
Slayer's Advance (Ex) : At 13th level, a slayer can move up to twice his base speed once per day as a move action.

semanticContracts.name: Icy Skin (Ex) L564
conditions: At 17th level, you gain immunity to cold.
Icy Skin (Ex) : You gain resist cold 5.
This resistance increases to 10 at 5th level and 20 at 11th level.

semanticContracts.name: Spark Skin (Ex) L579
conditions: At 17th level, you gain immunity to electricity.
Spark Skin (Ex) : You gain resist electricity 5.
This resistance increases to 10 at 5th level and 20 at 11th level.

semanticContracts.name: Molten Skin (Ex) L470
conditions: At 17th level, you gain immunity to fire.
Molten Skin (Ex) : You gain resist fire 5.
This resistance increases to 10 at 5th level and 20 at 11th level.

semanticContracts.name: Flight (Su) L432
conditions: At 1st level, the witch can use feather fall at will and gains a +4 racial bonus on Swim checks.
At 3rd level, she can cast levitate once per day.
At 5th level, she can fly, as per the spell, for a number of minutes per day equal to her level.
Flight (Su) : The witch grows lighter as she gains power, eventually gaining the ability to fly.
These minutes do not need to be consecutive, but they must be spent in 1-minute increments.
This hex only affects the witch.

semanticContracts.name: Tongues (Su) L442
conditions: At 5th level, a witch can use this ability to speak any language, as per tongues .
This duration does not need to be consecutive, but it must be spent in 1-minute increments.

semanticContracts.name: Bleeding Wounds (Su) L448
conditions: At 5th level, and every five levels thereafter, this damage increases by 1.

semanticContracts.name: Healing (Su) L436
conditions: At 5th level, this hex acts like cure moderate wounds .
Once a creature has benefited from the healing hex, it cannot benefit from it again for 24 hours.
This acts as a cure light wounds spell, using the witch's caster level.

semanticContracts.name: Resolute (Ex) L434
conditions: At 6th level, and every four levels thereafter, the amount of damage the cavalier can convert increases by 1.
This ability cannot be used to convert ability damage, ability drain, or energy damage to nonlethal damage.

semanticContracts.name: Pool Strike (Su) L414
conditions: At 6th level, and every three levels thereafter, the amount of damage dealt by this attack increases by 1d6.
If he misses with this attack, he can hold the charge for up to 1 minute before it dissipates.

semanticContracts.name: Battlefield Clarity (Ex) L432
conditions: At 7th and 15th level, you can use this ability one additional time per day.
You must take the second result, even if it is worse.

semanticContracts.name: Delay Affliction (Su) L497
conditions: At 7th and 15th level, you can use this ability one additional time per day.

semanticContracts.name: Studied Target (Ex) L406
semanticContracts.contract: At 7th level, a slayer can study an opponent as a move or swift action.
conditions: At 7th level, a slayer can study an opponent as a move or swift action.

semanticContracts.name: Fluid Travel (Su) L561
conditions: This duration does not need to be consecutive, but it must be spent in 1-hour increments.
You can use this ability for 1 hour per day per oracle level.

semanticContracts.name: Gaze of Flames (Su) L468
conditions: At 7th level, you can gaze through any source of flame within 10 feet per oracle level, as if using clairvoyance .

semanticContracts.name: Resist Life (Su) L452
conditions: At 7th level, you receive channel resistance +2.
This bonus increases by +2 at 11th and 15th level.

semanticContracts.name: Fortune (Su) L434
conditions: At 8th level and 16th level, the duration of this hex is extended by 1 round.
Fortune (Su) : The witch can grant a creature within 30 feet a bit of good luck for 1 round.
He must decide to use this ability before the first roll is made.
Once a creature has benefited from the fortune hex, it cannot benefit from it again for 24 hours.

semanticContracts.name: Misfortune (Su) L438
conditions: At 8th level and 16th level, the duration of this hex is extended by 1 round.
This hex affects all rolls the target must make while it lasts.
Whether or not the save is successful, a creature cannot be the target of this hex again for 1 day.

semanticContracts.name: Evil Eye (Su) L430
conditions: At 8th level the penalty increases to –4.

semanticContracts.name: Charm (Su) L424
conditions: At 8th level, this effect improves the attitude of the target creature by 2 steps.
Whether or not the save is successful, a creature cannot be the target of this hex again for 1 day.

semanticContracts.name: Calling (Ex) L443
conditions: He must declare that he is using this bonus before the roll is made.

semanticContracts.name: Flying Kick L485
conditions: At the end of this movement, the monk must make an attack against an adjacent foe.
Before the attack, the monk can move a distance equal to his fast movement bonus.
The attack made after the movement must be a kick.

semanticContracts.name: Learn from a Scroll L500
conditions: At the end of this time, the witch must make a Spellcraft check (DC 15 + spell level).
If the check fails, the process went awry in some way and the spell is not learned, although the scroll is still consumed.
Learn from a Scroll : A witch can use a scroll to teach her familiar a new spell.

semanticContracts.name: Familiar Teaching Familiar L498
conditions: At the end of this time, the witch whose familiar is learning a spell must make a Spellcraft check (DC 15 + spell level).
If the check succeeds, the familiar has learned the spell and the witch may utilize it the next time she prepares spells .
Most witches require a spell of equal or greater level in return for this service.
To accomplish this, the familiars must spend one hour per level of the spell being taught in communion with one another.

semanticContracts.name: Bane (Su) L434
conditions: Bane (Su) : At 5th level, an inquisitor can imbue one of her weapons with the bane weapon special ability as a swift action.
This ability lasts for a number of rounds per day equal to the inquisitor's level.
This ability only functions while the inquisitor wields the weapon.

semanticContracts.name: Bonus Feat L392
conditions: The cavalier must meet the prerequisites of these bonus feats.
These bonus feats must be selected from those listed as combat feats.

semanticContracts.name: Bonus Feats L424
conditions: He must meet the prerequisites for these feats as normal.
These bonus feats must be selected from those listed as combat, item creation, or metamagic feats.

semanticContracts.name: High Jump (Ex) L458
conditions: By spending 1 point from his ki pool as a swift action, the monk gains a +20 bonus on Acrobatics checks to jump for 1 round.

semanticContracts.name: Wholeness of Body (Su) L476
conditions: By spending 2 points from his ki pool, he can heal an amount of damage equal to 1d8 + his monk level.

semanticContracts.name: Cauldron (Ex) L422
semanticContracts.contract: Cauldron (Ex) : The witch receives Brew Potion as a bonus feat and a +4 insight bonus on Craft (alchemy) skill checks.
conditions: Cauldron (Ex) : The witch receives Brew Potion as a bonus feat and a +4 insight bonus on Craft (alchemy) skill checks.

semanticContracts.name: Cavalier's Charge (Ex) L389
conditions: Cavalier's Charge (Ex) : At 3rd level, a cavalier learns to make more accurate charge attacks while mounted.
In addition, the cavalier does not suffer any penalty to his AC after making a charge attack while mounted.
